flagged.evidence: The page says the power-map classification is 'obtained by lifting the composite with $\mathbb R/\mathbb Z\to\mathbb T$ to the universal cover of the circle'. For the identity character, this composite is the isomorphism epsilon: R/Z -> T, which has no continuous lift ell: R/Z -> R through the covering t -> exp(2 pi i t). Such a lift would make a(t)=ell([t]) continuous with a(t)-t integer-valued, hence constant on the connected real line. But a(1)=a(0), contradicting that constancy. The valid item proof first precomposes with p: R -> R/Z.
